messages:
maria: Quick check — retention milestone is coming up next Tue. We need: owner for the staging canary runbook, confirmation that tracing hooks are wired in staging, and a small PR review for the retention-config change. Who can take ownership of the runbook?
annie: I can own the canary runbook this cycle.
annie: I’ll draft a playbook and run through a dry run Wed morning.
jordan: I can take the PR review, ping the link here pls.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4823 — it changes default retention to 90d and adds retention-labels. Small test added.
sam: Tracing hooks were merged into staging yesterday — commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/commit/abcd1234. I validated spans for the dashboard load path.
kai: Heads up: dashboard ingestion latency spikes if retention-chunking is off. Add this alert in staging so we catch regressions:
```sql
avg(latency_ms) by (route) > 150
```
deploy-bot: canary-deploy scheduled for staging at 2026-03-19T10:00:00Z (job-id: cb-0992). Will post logs to #eng-platform-canaries.
kevin: For the retention config, add this snippet to the helm values to enable soft-deletion window:
```yaml
observability:
  retentionDays: 90
  softDeleteWindowHours: 72
```
kevin: Also note: we need a migration to compact old traces — filed task T-4421 in backlog.
jordan: Quick review: PR looks good overall, tiny nit in tests (mock timestamp). I'll push a fix in a minute.
annie: I added the runbook draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/canaries/obs-retention-staging — assigned to @annie and @maria. Contains checklist and rollback steps.
maria: Amazing, thanks. Can someone add an alert on error-analysis view when error-rate for query-exec > 2%? That's a SLO we want to protect.
sam: I’ll add the alert rule and link it here after I test in staging.
jordan: pushed the PR fix. CI green. @maria @annie can we schedule the dry run for Wed 09:30 PT?
annie: Wed 09:30 PT works for me. I’ll invite platform oncal and eng-sre.
maria: Perfect. Last ask: please update the roadmap card with the retention milestone + owners before EOD so PMs can see it. :thumbsup:
annie: done — card updated, owners set, and notes added about the migration task. Link: https://board.internal/roadmap/console-observability
maria: Thanks team — will follow up after the dry run with any action items
